An entry whose table the snapshot has since gained is STALE and FAILS THE BUILD; so is an entry for a migration that no longer exists, or one that creates no table at all. It cannot rot into unread noise the way a hand-maintained gap list does (tech-debt #73).

To clear one: apply the migration, then re-run `SUPABASE_PAT=… node scripts/sql-harness/snapshot-live-schema.mjs` and delete its line.
